item.title: Kim Yong-nam running for Pyeongtaek-eul: “Innovation Party starts its top committee with ‘Yong-morning’ … they closed the door on unification first.” (평택을 출마 김용남 “혁신당, ‘용모닝’으로 최고위 시작…단일화 문 먼저 닫아”)
item.description:
“They say the Cho Kuk Innovation Party’s top committee meetings now start with ‘Yong-morning’ (meaning criticizing Kim Yong-nam every morning). I wish they would stop paying attention to me.” (“요즘 조국혁신당 최고위원회의는 ‘용모닝’(아침마다 김용남을 비판한다는 뜻)으로 시작한다더라. 내게 관심을 좀 꺼줬으면 좋겠다.”)

Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, strongly criticized his rival, Cho Kuk of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, in an interview held at a café in Sangam-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul on the 11th. He said, “Candidate Cho’s side was the one that first closed the door on unification.” Kim stated that if elected, his top priorities would be establishing a new KTX Gyeonggi Southern Station and resolving the chronic traffic problems in downtown Pyeongtaek. Kim, a former member of the Saenuri Party (the predecessor of the People Power Party), switched his party affiliation to the Reform Party in January 2024 before joining the Democratic Party ahead of the last presidential election. (6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 나서는 김용남 더불어민주당 후보는 지난 11일 서울 마포구 상암동 한 카페에서 한 인터뷰에서 경쟁자인 조국 조국혁신당 후보를 강하게 비판했다. 그는 “단일화의 문은 조 후보 쪽이 먼저 닫아버렸다”고 했다. 김 후보는 자신이 당선되면 케이티엑스(KTX) 경기남부역사 신설과 고질적인 평택 시내 교통 문제를 최우선적으로 해결하겠다고 했다. 새누리당(국민의힘 전신) 출신인 김 후보는 2024년 1월 개혁신당으로 당적을 옮긴 뒤 지난 대선 때 민주당에 입당했다.)

―Why should it be ‘Kim Yong-nam’ for Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul? (―왜 경기 평택을에 ‘김용남’이어야 하는가?)

“In an election landscape where Candidate Cho and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon are expected to take a significant portion of the progressive vote, I judged that I, who have support bases across different camps by advocating for real estate tax relief and such, am the right person to expand support among centrist voters.” (“조국 후보와 김재연 진보당 후보가 진보 성향 표를 상당 부분 가져갈 것으로 보이는 선거 지형에서 부동산 세제 완화 등을 주장하며 진영을 넘어선 지지 기반을 갖춘 제가 중도층 표심까지 확장할 적임자라고 판단했다.”)

―If elected, what is the first task you will pursue? (―당선되면 가장 먼저 추진할 과제는?)

“Establishing a new KTX Gyeonggi Southern Station and pushing for an early extension of the Shinansan Line are needed, but the traffic problem in the city center is truly severe. There are also many areas that aren't properly supplied with tap water or city gas. Equipping the overall urban infrastructure is an urgent priority.” (“케이티엑스 경기남부역사 신설, 신안산선 연장 사업 조기 추진도 필요한데, 시내 교통 문제가 정말 심각하다. 상수도나 도시가스가 제대로 공급되지 않는 곳도 많다. 전반적인 도시 인프라를 갖추는 게 급선무다.”)

―On the 11th, you apologized for your 2015 remarks, where you said regarding the Sewol Ferry disaster, ‘It’s urgent to review the budget for the Sewol Special Investigation Committee, which only wastes taxpayer money,’ and for your history of activities in former President Yoon Suk Yeol’s presidential campaign. (―지난 11일 세월호 참사 관련해 “국민 세금만 낭비하는 세월호 특조위 관련 예산을 점검하는 게 시급하다”고 한 2015년 발언과 윤석열 전 대통령 대선 캠프 활동 이력에 대해 사과했다.)

“My remarks were about the budget spending of the Sewol Special Investigation Committee. However, I saw a YouTube video from someone presumed to be a bereaved family member and thought that from their perspective, my remarks could be interpreted differently. The Yoon Suk Yeol administration ended as a failure more than any other administration. I thought I should also apologize for having been involved in the creation of that administration.” (“제 발언은 세월호 특조위 예산 사용과 관련된 것이었다. 그러나 유족으로 추정되는 분의 유튜브 영상을 보게 됐고 유족 입장에서는 제 발언을 다르게 받아들일 수 있겠다 생각했다. 윤석열 정권은 그 어느 정권보다도 실패로 끝났다. 그 정권 탄생에 관여했던 것도 사과드려야 한다고 생각했다.”)

―Candidate Cho and the Innovation Party say, ‘Candidate Cho better aligns with the Democratic Party’s reformist line,’ and call you ‘prosecutor-like.’ (―조 후보와 혁신당은 ‘조 후보가 민주당 개혁노선에 더 부합한다’, 김 후보를 두고 ‘검사스럽다’고 한다.)

“Does someone who has never been a Democratic Party member for even a single day have the right to say such things? What has (Candidate Cho) actually done, having been pardoned through a Liberation Day amnesty after the government was launched, to help the Lee Jae-myung administration? Claiming I’m ‘prosecutor-like’ is also framing. They say the Innovation Party’s top committee now starts with ‘Yong-morning’—whether they gang up on me 13 to 1 or not, I don’t care; I wish they would just stop paying attention to me.” (“민주당원이었던 적이 단 하루도 없던 사람이 그런 말을 할 자격이 있나. (조 후보야말로) 정부 출범 뒤 광복절 특사로 사면받고 나와 이재명 정부를 도운 게 뭐가 있나. ‘검사스럽다’는 것도 프레임 씌우기다. 요즘 혁신당 최고위는 ‘용모닝’으로 시작한다던데 (조 후보와 혁신당 의원 등) 13 대 1로 붙든지 말든지 관심 없고 내게 그만 관심을 꺼줬으면 좋겠다.”)

―There is also a view that the negative campaigning between the two candidates is intense. (―두 후보의 네거티브전이 격하다는 시선도 있다.)

“If I take out the court ruling related to Candidate Cho Kuk and start scrutinizing him, I can do it better than anyone. But have I ever brought up, for instance, the admissions corruption issues first? I haven’t thrown a single punch.” (“조국 후보 쪽 판결문 가져다 놓고 그를 검증하기 시작하면 어느 누구보다 잘할 수 있다. 그런데 제가 가령 입시 비리 관련해 먼저 언급한 적 있나. 전 한 대도 안 때렸다.”)

―People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong criticizes you for having no ties to the region. (―유의동 국민의힘 후보는 김 후보가 지역 연고가 없다고 비판한다.)

“Saying in Pyeongtaek, now a large metropolitan city in the capital area, that ‘because you weren’t born here, you shouldn’t run here’ is a notion that would have been hard to come by even back in the ‘Pyeongtaek-gun’ days. Two out of five candidates (including Candidate Cho, who sparked controversy with the ‘Pyeongtaek-gun’ remark) are still living in Pyeongtaek-gun.” (“수도권 대도시가 된 평택시에서 ‘여기서 태어나지 않았으니 여기 출마하면 안 된다’는 건 옛날 ‘평택군’ 시절에도 나오기 힘든 발상이다. 후보 5명 중 2명(‘평택군’ 발언으로 논란된 조 후보 포함)은 아직 평택군에 살고 있는 거다.”)

―Is there a possibility of unification with Candidate Cho Kuk or Candidate Kim Jae-yeon? Are there conditions or a timeframe? (―조국 후보나 김재연 후보와 단일화 가능성은. 조건이나 시점이 있나?)

“Didn’t Candidate Cho’s side close the door on unification? They started negative campaigning even before my nomination was confirmed. Unification is only possible when there is a sense of solidarity. As of now, I am not considering it at all.” (“단일화의 문은 조 후보 쪽이 닫아버린 것 아닌가. 제 공천이 확정되기 전부터 네거티브를 시작했다. 단일화도 연대의식이 있을 때 가능하다. 지금으로선 전혀 생각하고 있지 않다.”)

By Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee to Meet US Treasury Secretary Bessent on Monday; Discuss US-China Summit (이 대통령, 내일 베선트 미 재무장관 접견…미·중 정상회담 등 논의)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung will meet with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on the 13th. (이재명 대통령이 13일 스콧 베선트 미국 재무장관을 접견한다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jeong stated on the 12th, “President Lee will receive a courtesy call from US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on the 13th and will hold a meeting.” President Lee is expected to exchange views with Secretary Bessent on the US-China summit scheduled for the 14th. In particular, issues such as US-China tariff disputes and global supply chain stability measures are expected to be on the agenda. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 12일 “이 대통령은 13일 스콧 베선트 미 재무장관의 예방을 받고 접견할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 베선트 장관과 오는 14일로 예정된 미-중 정상회담에 대한 의견을 교환할 것으로 전망된다. 특히 미·중 관세 문제와 글로벌 공급망 안정 방안 등이 대화 테이블 위에 오를 것으로 관측된다.)

Whether bilateral issues between South Korea and the US will be discussed during this meeting is also a point of interest. Specific details of investment projects in the US, a follow-up measure to the South Korea-US tariff negotiations, or contributions to freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz could also be discussed. Secretary Bessent will visit South Korea on the 13th to attend high-level bilateral economic and trade talks before the US-China summit. (이번 접견에서 한·미 간 현안에 대한 논의가 이뤄질지도 관심사다. 한·미 관세 협상 후속 조처인 대미투자 프로젝트의 구체적인 사업 내용이나 호르무즈해협 자유항행을 위한 기여 방안에 대한 의견도 오갈 수 있다. 베선트 장관은 미-중 정상회담에 앞서 한국에서 열리는 양국 고위급 경제·무역 회담에 참석하기 위해 13일 방한한다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Launches 'Jang Dong-hyuk One-Top Campaign Committee'... Co-Chair U Jae-jun Says "Announced Without Consultation" (국힘 ‘장동혁 원톱 선대위’ 출범…공동선대위원장 우재준은 “상의 없이 발표”)
item.description:
With 22 days to go until the June 3 local elections, the People Power Party has effectively launched a central election committee under a one-top system led by Representative Jang Dong-hyuk. However, Supreme Council member U Jae-jun, a member of the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction, who was named as co-campaign committee chair that day, pushed back, saying, "I never agreed to this. I regret that it was announced without consulting me." (6·3 지방선거를 22일 앞두고 국민의힘이 사실상 장동혁 대표 원톱 체제의 중앙선거대책위를 출범시켰다. 그런데 이날 공동선대위원장으로 이름이 올라간 친한동훈계인 우재준 최고위원은 “동의한 적이 없다. 상의 없이 발표한 것에 유감”이라고 반발했다.)

On the 12th, the People Power Party issued a press release announcing the formation of the "National Election Committee to Stop the Cancellation of the People-Disregarding Judgment Prosecution" with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk as the standing co-chairman. Alongside Representative Jang, private experts such as Shim Kyo-eon, a professor in the Department of Real Estate at Konkuk University; Yang Jun-mo, a professor in the Department of Economics at Yonsei University; Lee Yoon-jin, a professor at the Institute for Healthy Aging Society at Konkuk University; and Choi Ji-ye, a director at Jiyesu Co., Ltd., were listed as standing co-chairmen. The People Power Party announced that the co-campaign committee chairs would be floor leader Song Eon-seok, policy committee chairman Jeong Jeom-sik, and Supreme Council members Shin Dong-wook, Kim Min-su, Kim Jae-won, U Jae-jun, and Jo Gwang-han. (국민의힘은 12일 보도자료를 내어 장동혁 대표를 상임선대위원장으로 하는 ‘국민무시 심판 공소취소 저지 국민선거대책위원회’ 구성을 발표했다. 상임선대위원장에는 장 대표와 함께 심교언 건국대 부동산학과 교수, 양준모 연세대 경제학과 교수, 이윤진 건국대 건강고령사회연구원 교수, 최지예 주식회사 지예수 이사 등 민간 전문가들이 이름을 올렸다. 국민의힘은 공동선대위원장은 송언석 원내대표와 정점식 정책위의장, 신동욱·김민수·김재원·우재준·조광한 최고위원이 맡는다고 발표했다.)

However, after the announcement, Supreme Council member U Jae-jun posted on Facebook, stating, "I never agreed to my appointment as co-campaign committee chair," and pushed back, saying, "Given the concerns of candidates in the metropolitan area, there needs to be discussion on the proper way to form the campaign committee." In response, a party leadership official said, "Since the Supreme Council transitions to a campaign committee system during the election phase, Supreme Council members are naturally included." (그러나 우재준 최고위원은 발표 이후 페이스북에 글을 올려 “저는 공동선대위원장 임명에 동의한 적이 없다”며 “수도권 후보자들의 우려가 있는 상황에서 적절한 선대위 구성 방법에 대해서는 논의가 필요하다”고 반발했다. 이에 당 지도부 관계자는 “최고위원회가 선거 국면에서는 선대위 체제로 전환되는 거라 최고위원들은 당연히 포함되는 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Sexual Exploitation Site Operators Arrested...Will Track to the End and Punish Severely" (이 대통령 “성 착취물 사이트 운영진 검거…끝까지 추적해 엄벌”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 12th, "We have additionally arrested the operators who opened and ran an illegal sexual exploitation site in 2022 and had fled abroad," adding, "We will track them to the end and impose severe punishment." (이재명 대통령은 12일 “2022년 불법 성착취물 사이트를 개설·운영하며 해외에 도피해 있던 운영진을 추가로 검거했다”며 “끝까지 추적해 엄벌하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee posted a message on Instagram that afternoon, saying, "We have identified 9 out of 15 operator-level individuals, arrested 8 of them, and also arrested 204 users." (이 대통령은 이날 오후 인스타그램에 글을 올려 “운영자급 15명 중 9명을 특정해 8명을 검거했으며, 이용자 204명도 함께 검거했다”며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

President Lee said, "This is only the beginning," and added, "We will continue to track the top administrators who have not yet been arrested, the remaining forces, and the criminal proceeds." He also issued a warning: "If you thought you could hide overseas and escape the judgment of the law, that is a clear miscalculation." (이 대통령은 “시작에 불과하다”며 “아직 검거되지 않은 최고 관리자와 잔존 세력, 그리고 범죄수익에 대해서도 끝까지 추적할 것”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “해외로 숨어 법의 심판을 피할 수 있다고 생각했다면 이는 명백한 오산”이라는 경고도 남겼다.)

President Lee stated, "Digital sexual violence is a serious crime that tramples on human dignity and a social evil that can never be tolerated." He continued, "I issue a stern warning to everyone involved in the production, distribution, and consumption of illegal sexual exploitation material at this very moment. Do not think you can hide behind anonymity. Digital traces always remain. It is only a matter of time; there is no way to evade responsibility." (이 대통령은 “디지털 성폭력은 인간의 존엄의 짓밟는 중대한 범죄이며, 결코 용납할 수 없는 사회악”이라고 했다. 이어 이 대통령은 “지금 이 순간에도 불법 성착취물 제작, 유통, 소비에 가담하고 있는 모든 이들에게 엄중히 경고한다”며 “익명성 뒤에 숨을 수 있다고 생각하지 마십시오. 디지털 흔적은 반드시 남는다. 시간의 문제일 뿐 책임을 피할 수 있는 방법은 없다”고 했다.)

President Lee wrote, "Watching illegal content is also a clear crime." He added, "As long as demand exists, crime repeats itself. Even simple users will inevitably pay the price, without exception." (이 대통령은 “불법 콘텐츠를 시청하는 것 역시 명백한 범죄”라고 썼다. 이 대통령은 “수요가 존재하는 한 범죄는 반복된다”며 “단순 이용자라 하더라도 예외 없이 반드시 대가를 치르게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

By Choi Ha-yan, Reporter chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: A 'Present Arms' Garden of Gratitude... Even Sparking Election Law Controversy? [Gongdeok Pocha] (‘받들어 총’ 감사의 정원…선거법 위반 논란까지? [공덕포차])
item.description:
The 'Garden of Gratitude' created at Seoul's Gwanghwamun Square was unveiled to the public for the first time on the 12th with a completion ceremony. However, as controversy continues to swirl around the structure reminiscent of a 'present arms' salute, it has emerged as a hot-button issue in the Seoul mayoral election. Se-hoon Oh, the People Power Party (PPP) candidate for Seoul mayor who led the project, said, "I hope it becomes a symbol of solidarity that resonates with citizens worldwide," but Won-oh Jung, the Democratic Party (DP) candidate for Seoul mayor, countered, "Over 20 billion won in taxpayer money has been invested, and the original purpose has been significantly undermined." Some in the opposition and civil society point out that unveiling the structure just before the election could violate the Public Official Election Act. <<> In Busan's Buk-gu Gap, considered the biggest battleground in the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly, tensions over TV debates are heating up. item.title: People Power Party Confirms Yun Yong-geun as Candidate for By-election in Gongju, Buyeo, Cheongyang (국힘, 공주·부여·청양 보궐 후보에 윤용근 확정)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) announced on the 12th that Yun Yong-geun, the representative lawyer at law firm L Plus, has been decided as the candidate for the National Assembly by-election in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, South Chungcheong Province. (국민의힘은 12일 충남 공주·부여·청양 국회의원 보궐선거 후보로 윤용근 법무법인 엘플러스 대표변호사가 결정됐다고 밝혔다.)

The PPP’s Central Party Nomination Management Committee stated on the same day that after conducting a two-day primary election starting the 11th among three candidates who applied for nomination in Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang, Representative Lawyer Yun was chosen. Candidate Yun competed against So Jeong-im, the Deputy Head of the party's Finance Committee, and Yun Min-a, a former administrative officer at the Office of the Prime Minister. The primary was conducted using a method of 50% party member delegate voting and 50% general public opinion polling. (국민의힘 중앙당 공천관리위원회는 이날 공주·부여·청양에 공천을 신청한 후보 3명을 대상으로 지난 11일부터 이틀간 경선한 결과 윤 대표변호사가 후보로 결정됐다고 밝혔다. 윤 후보는 소정임 당 재정위원회 부위원장, 윤민아 전 국무총리실 사무관과 경쟁했다. 경선은 당원 선거인단 투표(50%), 일반 국민 여론조사(50%) 방식으로 실시됐다.)

Representative Lawyer Yun is from Buyeo and graduated from Jangam Elementary School, Jangam Middle School, and Buyeo High School. He studied law at Chungnam National University, passed the bar exam, and has worked as a lawyer. He currently serves as the party’s media spokesperson. (윤 대표변호사는 부여 출신으로 장암초·장암중·부여고를 졸업했다. 충남대 사법학과에 진학해 사법시험 합격 뒤 변호사로 활동했다. 현재는 당 미디어대변인을 맡고 있다.)

With his confirmation as the PPP candidate, Representative Lawyer Yun will now face Kim Young-bin (a lawyer), who was previously nominated by the Democratic Party of Korea. (윤 대표 변호사는 이날 국민의힘 후보로 확정됨에 따라 앞서 더불어민주당이 공천한 김영빈 후보(변호사)와 맞붙게 됐다.)

By Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Austerity Ignores People's Hardships"… President Lee Strengthens Expansionary Fiscal Policy Stance (“긴축은 민생고 방관”…이 대통령 적극재정 기조 강화)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 12th, "The government must focus its efforts on laying the groundwork for a major economic leap for the people through proactive fiscal policies." President Lee instructed that the expansionary fiscal policy be reflected in the formulation of the second-half economic growth strategy, to be announced in June, and in the preparation of next year's budget plan. (이재명 대통령이 12일 “정부는 적극적인 재정 정책을 통해 국민 경제 대도약의 발판을 닦는 데 역량을 집중해야 한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 오는 6월 발표할 하반기 경제성장 전략 수립과 내년도 예산안 편성에 적극 재정 정책을 반영하라고 지시했다.)

At a Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office, President Lee said, "Research results have confirmed that active and strategic fiscal management can provide substantial momentum to the people's economy." He added, "The livelihood recovery coupons distributed last year had the effect of boosting local small business sales by an additional 43,000 won per 100,000 won, achieving a total economic effect of 143,000 won for every 100,000 won of fiscal input." Earlier, on the 7th, the Korea Institute of Public Finance had released research findings containing this content. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “재정의 적극적이고 전략적인 운영이 민생경제에 실질적 동력을 제공할 수 있다는 점이 연구 결과로 확인됐다”며 “지난해 지급된 민생회복 쿠폰이 지역 소상공인 매출을 100만원당 추가로 43만원가량 늘리는 효과를 거뒀다. 100만원의 재정 투입을 통해 총 143만원의 경제적 효과를 거둔 것”이라고 말했다. 앞서 지난 7일 한국조세재정연구원은 이런 내용을 담은 연구 결과를 발표했다.)

President Lee remarked, "Despite these objective facts, there are voices in some parts of society demanding austerity as if it’s a constant refrain. They cite national debt as a pretext, but in reality, it’s an irresponsible call to simply stand by and ignore the people’s hardships." This was a rebuttal to criticism from the People Power Party and others, who have denounced the Lee Jae-myung administration's expansionary fiscal policy as a "money-printing populism budget that wrecks fiscal soundness." (이 대통령은 “이런 객관적 사실에도 마치 돌림노래처럼 긴축을 강요하는 목소리가 사회 일각에 존재한다. 국가 채무를 명분으로 들고는 있는데 사실상 민생 고통을 수수방관하라는 무책임한 목소리”라고 말했다. 국민의힘 등이 이재명 정부의 확장재정 정책을 “재정 건전성을 파탄내는 ‘돈풀리즘’ 예산”이라고 비판한 것을 일축한 것이다.)

President Lee said, "There was a time when frugality was a virtue, but now we live in a society where the problem is that money isn't circulating. In times of crisis, saving is also important, but we need to invest more in strengthening the nation's capacity. By revitalizing domestic demand through proactive fiscal measures and raising the economic growth rate and GDP, we can enhance potential growth and productivity in the process, creating a virtuous cycle that thickens the economic growth base." (이 대통령은 “한때 절약이 미덕일 때가 있었지만, 지금은 돈이 안 돌아서 문제인 사회가 됐다”며 “위기 시대에는 아끼는 것도 중요한데 오히려 국가의 역량을 키우는 데 투자할 필요가 있다. 적극적인 재정을 통해 내수를 활성화하고 경제성장률과 국내총생산(GDP)을 높이면 이 과정에서 잠재 성장률과 생산성이 제고돼 경제 성장판이 두터워지는 선순환 구조를 실현할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

President Lee stressed, "We must not fall into the trap of populist austerity fiscal theory that deceives the eyes of the people," adding, "I urge you to proceed with the formulation of the second-half economic growth strategy and next year's budget based on this (expansionary fiscal) stance." (이 대통령은 “국민의 눈을 속이는 포퓰리즘적인 긴축재정론의 함정에 빠져서는 안 된다”며 “이런 (적극 재정) 기조를 바탕으로 하반기 경제 성장 전략 수립과 내년도 예산 편성에 임해주길 당부드린다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the private bad bank 'Sangnoksu,' established during the 2003 credit card crisis, which has not participated in the government's debt relief policy for ordinary people and continues persistent debt collection, President Lee said, "It’s been 20 to 30 years since the credit card crisis—how are people supposed to live if they keep collecting like this now?" He added, "If necessary, we must find a solution, even through legislation." Shareholders of Sangnoksu have shown a passive attitude toward the request to sell long-overdue bonds to the government's bad bank, the 'New Start Fund,' resulting in no support for the rehabilitation of about 90,000 people with bonds totaling 700 billion won as of the end of last year. It is reported that the shareholders have also received about 42 billion won in dividends over the past five years. (한편 이 대통령은 2003년 카드 대란 당시 설립된 민간 배드뱅크 ‘상록수’가 정부의 서민 빚 탕감 정책에 참여하지 않고, 집요한 추심을 하는 것에 관해 “카드 사태가 20~30년이 지났는데, 지금까지 (추심하면) 사람은 어떻게 살라는 거냐”며 “필요하면 입법해서라도 해결 방법을 찾아야 한다”고 말했다. 상록수 출자사들은 장기 연체 채권을 정부 배드뱅크 ‘새출발기금’으로 매각하라는 요청에 소극적 태도를 보이며 지난해 말 기준 약 9만명, 7000억원 규모 채권의 회생 지원이 이뤄지지 않았다. 출자사들은 최근 5년간 420억원가량의 배당도 받은 것으로 전해졌다.)

By Seo Young-ji and Shim Woo-sam yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 심우삼 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Hyung-joon "Did you receive a Cartier watch?"…Jeon Jae-soo "Why didn't you sell LCT?" (박형준 “까르띠에 시계 받았나”…전재수 “엘시티 왜 안 팔았나”)
item.description:
On the 12th, Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party candidate, and Park Hyung-joon, the People Power Party candidate, clashed in a TV debate for the June 3 local elections for Busan mayor. Candidate Jeon emphasized "completing Busan as a maritime capital," while Candidate Park stressed "continued development without interruption." (6·3 지방선거 부산시장 선거에 출마한 전재수 더불어민주당 후보와 박형준 국민의힘 후보가 12일 티브이(TV) 토론에서 맞붙었다. 전 후보는 “해양수도 부산 완성”을, 박 후보는 “중단 없는 발전 지속”을 내세웠다.)

In his opening remarks at the debate held at Busan MBC in Dong-gu, Busan, Candidate Jeon stated, "I will achieve the 'completion of the maritime capital' through the relocation of public institutions to Busan, attracting a maritime specialized court, and moving the headquarters of major shipping companies to Busan." Candidate Park highlighted his administrative achievements, saying, "Over the past five years (during his term as Busan mayor), the amount of investment attracted (to Busan) increased 28-fold compared to 2020." (전 후보는 이날 부산 동구 부산문화방송(MBC)에서 열린 토론회 머리발언에서 “공공기관 부산 이전과 해사전문법원 유치, 해운 대기업 본사 부산 이전 등을 통해 ‘해양수도 완성’을 이뤄내겠다”고 말했다. 박 후보는 “지난 5년 (부산시장 임기 동안 부산으로) 투자유치액이 2020년에 견줘 28배 증가하는 등의 성과가 있었다”고 시정 성과를 강조했다.)

Candidate Park pressed Candidate Jeon, asking, "Did you receive the Cartier watch (that you were allegedly given by the Unification Church) or not?" In response, Candidate Jeon mentioned that last month, the joint investigation team of prosecutors and police concluded the case with a 'no right to prosecute' decision, and rebutted, "You are engaging in negative campaigning with a concluded investigation result. Votes won't come from framing me as if I had suspicions but the prosecutors and police closed the case anyway." (박 후보는 전 후보를 향해 “(전 후보가 통일교로부터 받았다는 의혹이 불거진) 까르띠에 시계를 받았느냐 안 받았느냐”며 몰아붙였다. 이에 전 후보는 지난달 이 사건을 수사한 검경 합동수사본부가 ‘공소권 없음’ 결론을 내린 것을 언급하며 “종결된 수사 결과를 가지고 네거티브를 하고 있다”며 “제게 혐의가 있는데도 검경이 사건을 종결한 것처럼 프레임을 씌워선 표가 나오지 않는다”고 반박했다.)

Candidate Jeon brought up the controversy over preferential sales of LCT (Lotte Chemical Tower) involving Candidate Park during the 2021 Busan mayoral by-election, attacking him by saying, "Didn't Candidate Park promise to sell LCT? Isn't failing to keep that promise a lie?" Candidate Park responded, "I'm unable to sell it because I've become a kind of lease damage victim. I'm sorry for not keeping my word." (전 후보는 2021년 부산시장 보궐선거 당시 불거졌던 박 후보의 엘시티(LCT) 특혜 분양 의혹을 언급하며 “박 후보는 엘시티를 판다고 약속하지 않았느냐. 지키지 않는 것은 거짓말이 아니냐”고 공격했다. 박 후보는 “일종의 전세 피해자가 돼서 못 팔고 있다. 공언한 것을 지키지 못해서 죄송하다”고 했다.)

item.title: “Jung Won-oh, Worried About Halting Redevelopment” “Seoul’s North-South Gap Widened Under Oh Se-hoon” (“정원오, 재개발 멈출까 걱정” “오세훈 시절 강남·북 격차 커져”)
item.description:
The key to the June 3 local elections for Seoul mayor lies in real estate and development. Jung Won-oh of the Democratic Party and Oh Se-hoon of the People Power Party are locked in near-daily debates over real estate policies. Each candidate is pushing their own property and development agenda, with Jung expanding his reach into Gangnam and Oh into Gangbuk. On the 12th, The Hankyoreh visited the four Gangnam districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa, and Gangdong-gu), where Jung is weaker, and the Gangbuk areas of Nowon, Dobong, Gangbuk-gu, and Eunpyeong-gu, where Oh is weaker, to hear from residents. (6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거전을 압축하는 열쇳말은 부동산과 개발이다. 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 거의 매일 부동산 정책을 두고 설전을 벌이고 있다. 두 후보는 각자의 부동산, 개발 정책을 들고 정 후보는 강남으로, 오 후보는 강북으로 외연 확장에 열심이다. 한겨레는 12일 정 후보의 약세지인 강남 4구(강남·서초·송파·강동구)와 오 후보의 약세지인 강북 노·도·강(노원·도봉·강북구)과 은평구를 찾아 시민들의 말을 들었다.)

"Worried Jung Won-oh as Mayor Would Halt Redevelopment and Reconstruction" <<> "It seems like he's making redevelopment promises just to gain popularity in Gangnam, but I dislike the populism of the Lee Jae-myung administration so much, and it looks like everything will turn blue (Democratic Party), so I’m considering casting a protest vote." (A 57-year-old man named Kwon) <<> "Meeting Jung Won-oh in person eased my concerns quite a bit about reconstruction being blocked." (Ma Jong-hyuk, head of the Gaepo Usung 7th Apartment Reconstruction Union) <<> Gangnam residents have mixed views on Jung Won-oh, who is courting conservative votes in the area. Jung has demanded the party form a special committee for the four Gangnam districts and has been visiting them daily, pledging to resolve local issues like redevelopment and reconstruction. That day, he unveiled a pledge to supply over 360,000 housing units by 2031. Given Seoul’s demographic structure, winning the Gangnam vote is crucial for victory. The population of the Gangnam area, which accounts for over 20% of Seoul’s total, has recently seen a slight increase. A member of Jung’s campaign explained, "We need to win in the Han River belt (Yongsan, Seongdong, Mapo, Yeongdeungpo, Dongjak, Gwangjin, Gangdong-gu, etc.) and perform well in Gangnam to secure election victory." <<> Lee (65), met outside the Apgujeong Hyundai Apartment reconstruction union office in Gangnam-gu on the 12th, said, "Under Mayor Park Won-soon, all redevelopment and reconstruction stopped. It was a lost decade." He added, "That trauma means I won’t vote for the Democratic Party." Ju (50), a resident of the Gaepo Usung 7th Apartment in Irwon-dong, remarked, "I don’t particularly like Oh Se-hoon, but the progressives (Democratic Party) take too much in taxes, so I plan to vote for the red party (People Power Party)." <<> In contrast, residents of Geoyeo-dong in Songpa-gu, where public redevelopment is being pursued, expressed hope. A woman in her 60s who runs a clothing store said, "Since I’m a commoner, I’m more likely to vote for Jung Won-oh over Oh Se-hoon, who only looks out for the rich." <<> Gangnam residents without a direct stake in redevelopment or reconstruction also voiced dissatisfaction with Jung’s real estate policies. Kim Yoo-jung (35), a resident of Gaepo-dong, said, "For those like me who rent, when nearby apartments are reconstructed, it only raises housing prices, making it harder to enter Gangnam." <<> <<> "Did the Gangnam-Gangbuk Gap Narrow Under Oh Se-hoon’s Term?" <<> "From a Gangbuk resident’s perspective, there’s definitely expectation for policies on transportation, housing, and living infrastructure pledges." (A 33-year-old office worker named Kim) <<> "Gangnam apartments cost billions of won, but our apartment, at 33 pyeong, is worth less than 1 billion won. I don’t know what Mayor Oh has done for Gangbuk so far. Residents of Nowon, Dobong, and Gangbuk don’t feel much impact." (A merchant at Ssangmun Market) <<> Gangbuk residents, while paying attention to Oh Se-hoon’s development pledges for the region, have not hidden their doubts about their feasibility. Oh recently unveiled the "Rapid Integrated Planning 2.0" pledge for redevelopment in Gangbuk and has been visiting Gangbuk-gu, Dobong-gu, and Eunpyeong-gu to court voters. <<> Lee Jang-gyu (40s), a real estate agent in Mia-dong, Gangbuk-gu, where the rapid integrated plan was finalized in March, explained, "Many people in this area have lived here for decades. They oppose redevelopment because money doesn’t just flow into their bank accounts." item.title: "'Garden of Gratitude' Bursting with Pride" Oh Se-hoon... "Strategic Role Division with Jang Dong-hyuk" (“‘감사의 정원’ 자부심 뿜뿜” 오세훈…“장동혁과 전략적 역할 분담”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, said on the 13th, "A strategic role division with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk is necessary." (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보는 13일 “장동혁 대표와 전략적 역할 분담이 필요하다”고 말했다.)

When asked on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show," "You've been urging Representative Jang for change. Do you consider this the change you wanted?" Candidate Oh replied, "I am conducting a new type of campaign through the Citizens' Election Committee, promoting Seoul's policies. Representative Jang Dong-hyuk continuing to criticize the 'Special Counsel for Repeal of Prosecution' or effectively condemning the government's absurd policies, such as the major blunder by former Blue House Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom yesterday—that's what the party leadership should do." (오 후보는 이날 SBS(에스비에스) 라디오 ‘김태현의 정치쇼’ 에서 “장 대표에게 변화를 계속 촉구했는데, 원하는 변화가 됐다고 보느냐”는 질문에 “저는 시민선대위를 통해 서울시의 정책을 알리는 등의 새로운 형태의 선거운동을 하고 있다. 장동혁 대표는 계속해서 ‘공소취소 특검’을 비판한다든가, 어제 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 대형사고를 친 것 등 정부의 터무니없는 정책을 효과적으로 비판하는 게 당 지도부가 할 일”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding the gap in approval ratings with Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate, Oh said "it's narrowing rapidly" and "if this trend continues, I can do it. However, the playing field is still heavily slanted, so I have to make desperate efforts." He added, "When it comes to self-praise, the fact that Seoul citizens have elected me four times is because I do my job well. I'm the original 'hard worker' and a 'policy front-runner.'" (오 후보는 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 지지율 격차가 “빠른 속도로 줄고 있다”며 “이 추세대로만 가면 할 수 있다. 다만 아직 운동장 자체가 많이 기울어져 있는 판이기 때문에 처절한 노력을 해야 한다”고 말했다. 그는 “선거니까 자화자찬 한다면 서울시민들이 저를 일 잘하니까 네 번이나 뽑아주신 것이고, 제가 원조 ‘일잘러’이고 정책 ‘앞질러’”라고 했다.)

Regarding the controversy over the 'Garden of Gratitude' at Gwanghwamun Square, which was completed the previous day, Oh said, "It is a space filled with the message of gratitude for the tens of thousands of foreign youths who sacrificed themselves during the war, allowing South Korea to survive, and that thanks to them, South Korea has transformed into a country that provides aid. If students or citizens go and see it, they will feel bursting with pride." (오 후보는 전날 준공한 서울 광화문광장 ‘감사의 정원’ 논란과 관련해 “전쟁 때 수만명의 외국 젊은이들이 와서 희생해 대한민국이 생존한 데 대한 감사와 그 덕분에 대한민국이 원조를 주는 나라로 바뀌었다는 메시지가 가득한 공간”이라며 “학생들이나 국민들이 가서 보면 자부심 뿜뿜”이라고 말했다.)

The 23 structures, each 6.25 meters tall, symbolizing the 23 countries that participated in the Korean War, installed near the statue of King Sejong in Gwanghwamun Square, have sparked controversy as they resemble the shape of a "present arms" rifle salute. (광화문광장 세종대왕상 근처에 설치된 한국전쟁 참전 23개국을 상징하는 6.25m 높이 조형물 23개는 ‘받들어총’ 모양을 연상시켜 논란이 되고 있다.)

item.title: Cho Hyun: “Several possible actors behind the flying object strike on the ‘M/T HMM’…including Iranian militias” (조현 “‘나무호 타격’ 비행체 발사 주체 여럿 가능…이란 민병대 포함”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Hyun said on the 13th that it is currently impossible to conclude that the Iranian government was the actor that launched the “flying object” at a South Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, and that it could have been a militia group. <<> Minister Cho, meeting with reporters at the government complex in Seoul, responded to a question about whether the flying object that struck the M/T HMM likely came from a drone by stating: “It is difficult to specify prematurely. Particularly, regarding the actor that launched it, there could be many possibilities beyond just Iran. There could also be militias.” When asked if he was considering the possibility that the attacker was a militia, he said, “It’s not that I am considering it, but that there is a possibility.” <<> Some have raised the possibility that the flying object that struck the M/T HMM was a Shahed suicide drone, which Iran has frequently used in its conflicts with the United States. Such suicide drones, including the Shahed, are operated not only by Iran’s regular military and Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps but also by the Houthi rebels and militias backed by Iran. Minister Cho’s comments today are interpreted as meaning that even if the flying object is identified as an Iranian drone, it cannot be concluded which Iranian actor launched it. <<> The government plans to bring drone engine debris collected from the M/T HMM to South Korea for detailed analysis to identify the model of the flying object, then analyze the overall circumstances to make a final judgment on the attacker. When asked when the debris would arrive in South Korea, Minister Cho simply replied, “It needs to come quickly.” <<> Experts say that even if the engine debris recovered from the M/T HMM is identified as belonging to an Iranian drone, information such as the flight trajectory is crucial to clarify who launched it. Considering the circumstances at the time, when significant U.S. reconnaissance assets were concentrated in the Strait of Hormuz as part of Operation Liberation Project, intelligence cooperation with the U.S. is deemed important. <<> A senior government official, during a meeting with South Korean correspondents at the South Korean Embassy in Washington on the 12th (local time), stated regarding the M/T HMM incident that “it is true that we have had extensive discussions” with the U.S. side, but regarding specific details, he said, “there are many elements that limit what I can share.” When asked whether the South Korean government’s assessment was slower than that of the U.S., he replied, “We cannot make a definitive conclusion before it is confirmed,” adding, “We need to wait for the government’s joint investigative team’s conclusions.” <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr Washington / Special Correspondent Kim Won-chul wonchul@hani.co.kr (조현 외교부 장관은 13일 호르무즈해협에서 한국 선박에 ‘비행체’를 발사할만한 주체가 이란 정부라고 현재로서는 단정할 수 없고 민병대 등일 가능성도 있다고 말했다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] 4-term lawmaker Park Deok-heum elected as People Power Party’s candidate for Vice Speaker of the National Assembly ([속보] 4선 박덕흠, 국힘 몫 국회부의장 후보 선출)
item.description:
Park Deok-heum, a four-term lawmaker representing Boeun, Okcheon, Yeongdong, and Goesan in North Chungcheong Province, has been elected as the candidate for Vice Speaker of the National Assembly from the People Power Party. (국민의힘 몫 국회부의장 후보로 4선의 박덕흠 의원(충북 보은·옥천·영동·괴산)이 선출됐다.)

The People Power Party held a general meeting of its lawmakers at the National Assembly on the morning of the 13th and selected Park as the candidate for Vice Speaker. Park competed in a three-way race with lawmakers Cho Kyoung-tae (six-term, Saha-eul, Busan) and Cho Bae-sook (five-term, proportional representative). Subsequently, the National Assembly will hold a plenary session to finalize Park’s election as Vice Speaker. (국민의힘은 13일 오전 국회에서 당 의원총회를 열어 박 의원을 국회부의장 후보로 뽑았다. 박 의원은 조경태(6선·부산 사하을), 조배숙(5선·비례대표) 의원과 3파전을 벌였다. 이후 국회는 본회의를 열어 박 의원을 국회 부의장으로 최종 선출하게 된다.)

After challenging for the Vice Speaker position in the first half of the 22nd National Assembly, Park has now thrown his hat in the ring for the second time. Park, who currently serves as the chair of the People Power Party’s nomination management committee, was urgently deployed after the “first nomination management committee” for the June 3 local elections was disbanded midway, completing the nomination process. (박 의원은 22대 국회 전반기에 국회부의장에 도전한 데 이어 이번에 두 번째로 부의장 자리에 출사표를 던졌다. 현재 국민의힘 공천관리위원장인 박 의원은 6·3 지방선거 ‘1기 공천관리위원회’가 중도 해체된 뒤 긴급 투입돼 공천 작업을 마무리했다.)

A native of Okcheon, North Chungcheong Province, Park has served four consecutive terms representing Boeun, Okcheon, Yeongdong, and Goesan. In September 2020, while serving as a member of the National Assembly’s Land, Infrastructure, and Transport Committee for five years, a conflict of interest issue arose when it was revealed that his family’s company had won construction projects worth hundreds of billions of won from agencies under his committee’s oversight. He left the party over the controversy but rejoined in January 2022. (충북 옥천 출신으로 보은·옥천·영동·괴산에서 내리 4선을 지낸 박 의원은 2020년 9월, 국회 국토교통위원회 위원으로 있던 5년간 가족 회사가 피감기관으로부터 수천억원대 공사를 수주했다는 이해충돌 문제가 불거져 탈당했다가 2022년 1월 복당한 바 있다.)

Reported by Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr and Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "People Power Party, an 'Insurrection Advocate,' Subject to Unconstitutional Party Dissolution... Must Face Voter Judgment in Local Elections" (정청래 “‘내란 옹호’ 국민의힘, 위헌정당 해산 대상…지선서 민심 심판 받아야”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 13th, "The People Power Party is an anti-constitutional, anti-democratic force that advocates insurrection and can be subject to a review for the dissolution of an unconstitutional party," adding, "Before any such dissolution review, they must face the severe judgment of the people in the upcoming June 3 local elections." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 13일 “국민의힘은 내란을 옹호하는 반헌법, 반민주 세력이며 위헌 정당 해산 심판의 대상이 될 수 있다”며 “위헌 정당 해산 심판 이전에 이번 6·3 지방선거에서 민심의 혹독한 심판을 받아야 한다”고 말했다.)

Leader Jung made these remarks during a press conference at the party leader's office in the National Assembly on this day, eight days before the start of the election campaign, where he reported on the progress of candidate nominations and policy achievements. "Through the June 3 local elections, we must decisively judge the forces of insurrection and eliminate even the traces of it," Jung emphasized. "By doing so, we must fully normalize the country and establish competent local governments to firmly support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (정 대표는 선거운동 시작일을 8일 앞둔 이날 국회 당대표 회의실에서 공천 경과와 정책 성과 등을 보고하는 기자회견을 열고 이렇게 말했다. 정 대표는 “6·3 지방선거를 통해 내란 세력을 확실하게 심판하고, 내란의 티끌까지도 청산해내야 한다”며 “이를 통해 국가를 완전히 정상화하고 일 잘하는 지방정부를 세워 이재명 정부의 성공을 든든하게 뒷받침해야 한다”라고 강조했다.)

Furthermore, Jung proudly described the nominations for this local election as "the unprecedented nominations of four 'no's and four strong points." He stated, "There were no unjust cuts, no nominations of unqualified candidates, no parachute appointments, and no corruption." He also added, "The party's policies and pledges are being consolidated into policies created together with party members and pledges made alongside the people," and reintroduced the major pledges the party had previously announced. (아울러 정 대표는 이번 지방선거 공천은 ‘역대급 4무 4강 공천’이라고 자부했다. 정 대표는 “억울한 컷오프가 없고, 부적격자 공천이 없고, 낙하산 공천 없고, 부정부패도 없었다”라고 했다. 또 “당의 정책과 공약 또한 당원들과 함께 만드는 정책, 국민과 함께 만드는 공약으로 집대성하고 있다”면서 그간 당이 발표했던 주요 공약들을 다시 소개했다.)

Regarding the election campaign, he pledged, "We will not use eye-sore, pollution-level banners that tear down other parties, but will instead conduct a policy- and performance-focused promotional campaign that resonates with the people, allowing them to feel a sense of reward and joy." He promised, "We will show an election campaign where we are 'one team, united as one.'" (선거 운동에 대해서도 “다른 당을 깎아내리며 눈살을 찌푸리게 하는 공해 수준의 도배 현수막이 아니라 국민이 공감할 수 있고, 국민이 보람과 기쁨을 느낄 수 있는 정책 중심, 성과 중심의 홍보전을 펼치겠다”라며 “‘혼연일체로 원팀이 되는 선거운동’을 보여드리겠다”라고 약속했다.)

By Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr and Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Defense Minister An Kyu-baek Meets US Navy Chief in Washington, Asks for Support for Nuclear Submarines as "Milestone in Alliance Upgrade" (방미 안규백 장관, 미 해군 수장 만나 “핵잠, 동맹격상 이정표” 지지 당부)
item.description:
South Korean Defense Minister An Kyu-baek, currently visiting the United States, has met with the acting US Secretary of the Navy to request support for South Korea's introduction of nuclear-powered submarines (nuclear subs). (미국을 방문 중인 안규백 국방부 장관이 미 해군성 장관 대행을 만나 한국의 핵추진잠수함(핵잠) 도입에 대한 지지를 요청했다.)

According to the Ministry of National Defense on the 13th, Minister An met with Acting US Navy Secretary Hung Cao in Washington on the morning of the 12th (local time) to discuss key alliance issues. Minister An emphasized that South Korea's introduction of nuclear subs would contribute to enhancing mutual security interests between South Korea and the US and serve as an important milestone in upgrading the South Korea-US alliance, urging active support from the Navy Department. He also stressed that South Korea not only possesses excellent shipbuilding productivity but has also established a legal basis for investment in the US through the enactment of a special law on investment in the US, making it the optimal partner for cooperation in the shipbuilding sector. <<> The two ministers agreed to continue close cooperation between the two countries going forward, the Ministry of National Defense reported. The US Department of Defense includes the Departments of the Army, Navy, and Air Force under its umbrella, with the Navy Department overseeing the Navy and Marine Corps. <<> The South Korea-US leaders agreed in a joint fact sheet from their two summits last year to cooperate on South Korea's construction of nuclear subs. However, subsequent negotiations have stalled due to US dissatisfaction with delays in South Korea's implementation of investments in the US and issues related to Coupang (or military base pollution issues as previously raised in some contexts, but here likely referring to general impasses) acting as a stumbling block. <<> During his visit to the US, Minister An also met with key congressional figures including US Senate Armed Services Committee Chairman Roger Wicker, committee ranking member Jack Reed, and Senator Rick Scott, chair of the Seapower Subcommittee, to discuss alliance issues such as the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON). He explained South Korea's will and efforts to take a leading role in defending the Korean Peninsula and emphasized the importance of maintaining a combined defense posture on the peninsula, before requesting support from the US Congress for OPCON transition and nuclear sub construction. On the 11th, he met with US Defense Secretary (referring to the Secretary of Defense, though the text mentions "전쟁부 장관" which could be an older term) Pete Hegseth to discuss pending issues including OPCON transition and South Korea's contributions to resuming navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. <<> In a meeting with correspondents at the South Korean Embassy in Washington on the same day, Minister An said regarding the push for nuclear sub construction, "I believe security issues should be approached on a different track from economic issues," and added, "While it's not an issue that can be resolved overnight given that the US is at war with Iran and trade issues are also entangled, we agreed that practical consultations should be convened as soon as possible, taking into account issues with China and North Korea." <<> A senior government official said this visit and talks were arranged at South Korea's proposal. He described it as "a procedural process of seeking understanding and persuasion through mutual communication, given the accumulation of various pending issues between South Korea and the US." <<> Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr <<> Kim Won-chul, Correspondent in Washington wonchul@hani.co.kr (13일 국방부에 따르면 안 장관은 12일(현지시각) 오전 워싱턴에서 헝 카오 미 해군성 장관대행을 접견하고 주요 동맹 현안을 논의했다. 안 장관은 한국의 핵잠 도입이 한·미 공동 안보이익 증진에 기여하고 한-미 동맹 격상의 중요한 이정표가 될 것이라고 강조하며 해군성 차원의 적극적인 지지를 당부했다. 한국이 함정 건조에 우수한 생산성을 보유하고 있을 뿐 아니라, 대미투자특별법 제정을 통해 대미투자의 법적 근거를 마련한 만큼 조선 협력에서 미국의 최적 협력 파트너라고도 강조했다.)

item.title: North Korea's Kim Jong-un "Strengthen Mortar and Howitzer Forces"… Inspects Munitions Factories in Successive Moves (북한 김정은 “박격포·곡사포 무력 강화”…연일 군수공장 시찰)
item.description:
North Korean leader Kim Jong-un inspected munitions factories producing shells and ordered the "strengthening of mortar and howitzer forces." (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 포탄 생산 군수공장을 시찰하고 ‘박격포와 곡사포 무력 강화'를 주문했다.)

The Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported on the 12th that Kim visited several munitions industrial sites the previous day for on-site guidance and "looked into the implementation status of munitions production tasks for the first half of 2026." (조선중앙통신은 12일 김 위원장이 전날 여러 군수공업기업소를 방문해 현지 지도하고 “2026년 상반년도 군수생산 과제 수행실태를 료해(파악)”했다고 보도했다.)

At a bullet manufacturing plant, Kim presented important tasks for establishing a production system to meet the demand for high-precision multi-purpose rounds of various calibers, special-function rounds, and training rounds. KCNA reported that Kim particularly emphasized the "strengthening of mortar and howitzer forces" and outlined key tasks for enhancing the modernity and specialization of artillery shell production plants, including "establishing a specialized artillery weapon production complex and a sniper weapon production plant to meet the prospective needs of our armed forces." Specific details of the tasks were not disclosed. (김 위원장은 총탄 생산공장에서 구경별 고정밀 다목적탄과 특수기능탄, 훈련탄의 수요와 그에 따르는 생산체계 확립을 위한 중요 과업을 제시했다. 그는 특히 “박격포와 곡사포 무력 강화”를 강조하면서 “우리 무력의 전망적 수요를 충족시키기 위하여 전문화된 포 무기 생산종합체와 저격 무기 생산공장 설립” 등 총포탄 생산공장의 현대성·전문성을 제고하기 위한 주요 과업을 밝혔다고 조선중앙통신은 전했다. 과업의 구체적인 내용은 공개하지 않았다.)

Kim stated, "Our munitions industry's structure, production systems, and facilities still harbor shortcomings," and added, "We must focus on practical renewal of production structures and rational arrangement of production processes for modernization, realize optimization in technical management, talent management, and labor management, and vigorously wage a struggle to continuously enhance production efficiency." (김 위원장은 “우리 군수공업의 구조와 생산체계, 시설들에 의연(여전히) 결점들이 잠재한다”며 “생산구조의 실용적인 갱신과 생산공정들의 합리적인 배치 등 현대화에 주력하며 기술관리, 인재관리, 로력(인력)관리의 최적화를 실현하고 생산의 효율성을 부단히 높여나가기 위한 투쟁을 힘있게 벌려나가야 한다”고 했다.)

Accompanying him on this inspection were Jo Chun-ryong, secretary of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, Kim Jong-sik, first deputy director of the Party's Munitions Industry Department, military veteran Park Jeong-cheon, advisor to the Ministry of National Defense, Kim Kang-il, vice minister of National Defense and director of the Equipment General Bureau, Yu Chang-seon, director of the Artillery Bureau of the General Staff, Kim Myeong-seon, director of the Weapons Review Bureau of the Ministry of National Defense, and Kim Yong-hwan, director of the National Defense Science Institute, among others. (이번 시찰에는 조춘룡 조선노동당 중앙위원회 비서, 김정식 당 군수공업부 제1부부장, 군부 원로 박정천 국방성 고문, 김강일 국방성 부상 겸 장비총국장, 유창선 총참모부 포병국장, 김명선 국방성 병기심사국장, 김용환 국방과학원장 등이 수행했다.)

Kim visited a "major munitions factory" on the 6th, stating he would deploy new 155mm self-propelled howitzers capable of targeting Seoul to the "southern border." On the 7th, accompanied by his daughter Ju-ae, he boarded the destroyer "Choi Hyun-ho" ahead of its commissioning to observe comprehensive evaluation tests, continuing his recent flurry of military activities. (김 위원장은 지난 6일 ‘중요군수기업소'를 방문해 서울을 사정권에 둘 수 있는 신형 155㎜ 자주포를 ‘남부 국경'에 배치하겠다고 밝혔고, 7일에는 딸 주애와 함께 취역을 앞둔 구축함 ‘최현호'에 탑승해 종합평가시험을 참관하는 등 연일 군사행보를 보이고 있다.)

Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok: "Han Dong-hoon didn't see a falling cameraman? That's like 'Biden-Nalimyeon' talk" (이준석 “한동훈, 넘어진 기자 못 봤다? ‘바이든-날리면’ 같은 얘기”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, criticized independent candidate Han Dong-hoon’s explanation that he "did not notice" a cameraman falling off a stage during his press conference for the by-election in Busan's Buk-gu Gap district, calling it "the same kind of story as 'Biden-Nalimyeon.'" (한동훈 부산 북갑 보궐선거 무소속 후보가 출마 기자회견 당시 카메라 기자가 무대에서 넘어지는 것을 “인지하지 못했다”고 해명한 것을 두고 이준석 개혁신당 대표가 “‘바이든-날리면’ 같은 이야기”라고 비판했다.)

In an appearance on YTN Radio's "Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang" on the 13th, Lee said, "Whether he saw it or not, it seems unlikely he didn't see it," adding, "To claim he didn't see it is, in my opinion, too much like the 'Biden-Nalimyeon' story." This refers to former President Yoon Suk-yeol's 2022 visit to the US, where he was reported as saying, "If those b*stards in the National Assembly don't approve it, Biden would be so embarrassed." When the media covered this, Yoon gave a far-fetched explanation that he said "Nalimyeon" (a type of noodle dish), not "Biden." Lee was drawing a parallel to Han's explanation. ( 이 대표는 13일 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 출연해 “(한 후보가) 봤냐, 못 봤냐, 못 본 건 아닌 것 같다”며 “그걸 못 봤다고 하기엔 너무나도 제 생각엔 ‘바이든-날리면’ 같은 이야기”라고 말했다. 지난 2022년 윤석열 전 대통령은 미국 방문 당시 “국회에서 이 ××들이 승인 안 해주면 바이든은 쪽팔려서 어떡하냐”고 발언한 내용을 언론에서 보도하자 “‘바이든’이 아니고 ‘날리면’”이라는 억지 해명을 내놓은 바 있다. 이를 한 후보의 해명에 빗댄 것이다. )

Lee further speculated, "But after seeing it, Han probably thought from his angle that the reporter was safe or had gotten up, and then moved on," adding, "Moments like that will gradually affect voters." ( 이 대표는 “그런데 보고 나서 한 후보 입장에서는 우리가 못 보는 시야에서 (기자가) 안전하구나 또는 털고 일어났구나 이 정도로 인지하고 가신 게 아닌가 생각한다”며 “그런 게 유권자에게는 조금씩 영향을 미치는 순간이 올 것”이라고 내다봤다. )

The cameraman's fall incident occurred on the 9th during Han's press conference at a small park near Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan. In a video uploaded to Han's official YouTube channel, a broadcast cameraman, while backing up to film Han stepping onto the stage, fell off it. Han's spokesperson, who collided with the falling cameraman, staggered significantly and also fell. ( 카메라 기자 추락 사고는 지난 9일 부산 북구 구포시장 근처 쌈지공원에서 열린 한 후보 출마 기자회견 현장에서 발생했다. 한 후보 공식 유튜브 채널에 올라온 영상을 보면, 한 방송사의 카메라 기자가 무대 위로 올라오는 한 후보를 찍기 위해 뒷걸음질을 치다 무대 아래로 떨어졌다. 떨어지는 카메라 기자와 부딪힌 한 후보의 대변인이 크게 휘청거리면서 함께 넘어지기도 했다. )

At the moment of the fall, Han was waving his hand while looking in the opposite direction, but immediately turned his head toward where the cameraman had fallen. Han continued to look in that direction for about four seconds, which led to the spread of the related video on YouTube and social media (SNS), drawing criticism that he was aware of the accident but remained indifferent. ( 떨어지는 순간 한 후보는 반대쪽을 바라보며 손을 흔들고 있었지만 직후 카메라 기자가 떨어진 쪽으로 고개를 돌렸다. 이후에도 한 후보는 4초가량 카메라 기자가 떨어진 쪽을 바라봤는데 이 때문에 유튜브와 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에서는 관련 영상이 확산하며 한 후보가 사고가 난 것을 알면서도 무신경했다는 비판이 일었다.)

Han's side countered on the 10th, saying, "Han did not notice the reporter falling, which is clearly verifiable in the video," and "Immediately after the situation occurred, Han checked with the host and was told, 'It's okay,' and then proceeded with the press conference." ( 한 후보 쪽에서는 10일 “한 후보는 해당 기자가 넘어지는 것을 인지하지 못했으며 이는 영상에서 충분히 확인 가능하다”고 반박했다. “상황 발생 직후 한 후보는 사회자에게 상황을 확인했으며, 현장에서 ‘괜찮다’는 답변을 받은 뒤 기자회견을 진행했다”는 것이다. )

However, the controversy does not seem to subside. People Power Party lawmaker Kwon Young-se, appearing on Channel A's "Politics Signal" on the 12th, said, "Looking at the video, you see Han turning around and looking, and people gathering as someone falls. There would have been murmuring and noise," adding, "I don't think he couldn't have known." He continued, "When there's a problem, it's better to honestly admit it and apologize. Trying to patch it up temporarily only makes it harder," criticizing, "He should have said, 'I saw it but I was careless,' or admitted what he could. But saying he didn't see it is a dishonest attitude." (하지만 논란은 사그라지지 않는 모양새다. 권영세 국민의힘 의원은 12일 채널에이(A) ‘정치시그널’에 나와 “영상을 보니까 (한 후보가) 뒤돌아서 쳐다보는 모습이 나오고 사람들이 쓰러지니까 몰리는 모습도 있다. 웅성웅성하고 소리도 났을 거고”라며 “(한 후보가) 몰랐을 리는 없겠다 생각한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “문제가 있을 때 솔직하게 인정하고 사과를 하는 게 좋지, 임시방편으로 막으려고 하면 그게 더 어렵다”며 “봤지만 제가 생각이 짧았다든지 바로 인정할 건 인정했어야지, 그걸 못 봤다. 이렇게 얘기하는 건 정직하지 못한 태도”라고 비판했다.)

In response, Han directly addressed the issue in an interview with KNN on the 12th. Han replied as follows: ( 그러자 한 후보는 12일 케이엔엔(KNN)과 인터뷰에서 직접 해명에 나섰다. 한 후보는 다음과 같이 답했다. )

"I saw our spokesperson lying there like that. Hey, what happened, I asked the spokesperson, and someone had helped him up, what was it? From my perspective, it seemed like that, and when I asked, 'Are you okay?' they said they were fine, so I moved on. I had no awareness of the situation at all, but still, they came to film my event properly, right? It doesn't seem like they were badly injured. But still, it could have been serious, and in that sense, I feel sorry." (“우리 대변인이 이렇게 넘어져 있더라고요. 어 왜 그러냐, 대변인한테 물어봤는데 한 분이 일으켰고 뭐지? 저는 이런 정도 상황이었는데 괜찮냐? 하니까 괜찮다고 해서 제가 넘어갔는데. 저는 그 당시 상황을 인지는 전혀 못 했습니다만 그래도 제 행사를 잘 찍어주시려고 오신 거잖아요. 많이 다치시거나 그런 거 같진 않아요. 그렇지만 그래도 큰일 날 뻔했다, 그런 점에서는 제가 죄송스럽게 생각한다는 마음이 있어요.”)

However, in the video released by Han's side and YouTube footage from different angles, no scene is confirmed where Han’s spokesperson, who was knocked over by the falling cameraman, makes eye contact or communicates verbally with Han immediately after the accident. ( 다만, 한 후보 쪽에서 공개한 영상과 다른 각도에서 찍은 유튜브 영상에서 추락한 카메라 기자와 부딪혀 넘어진 한 후보의 대변인이 사고 직후 한 후보와 눈을 맞추거나 말로 대화를 나누는 장면은 확인되지 않는 상황이다. )

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr ( 이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "King Sejong Looks Trapped Behind Bars"…Torrent of Criticism for Oh Se-hoon's 'Shoulder Arms' Monument (“세종대왕, 창살 갇힌 듯”…오세훈표 ‘받들어 총’ 비판 봇물)
item.description:
A stone monument reminiscent of a 'shoulder arms' pose has been installed at Gwanghwamun Square in Seoul amid controversy, drawing criticism from political circles and beyond. (‘받들어 총’을 연상시키는 석재 조형물이 논란 끝에 서울 광화문광장에 설치되자 정치권 등에서 비판이 이어지고 있다.)

Rep. Lee So-young of the Democratic Party of Korea posted on Facebook on the 12th, saying, "It looked so bizarre in photos that I came to see it in person after my schedule today," along with photos. She added, "In that square, which was serene with open views in all directions that just lifted your spirits just by walking, who installed such a grotesque sculpture that looks like animal carcass bones, and why?" She continued, "Looking from the Foreign Ministry side, King Sejong appears trapped behind bars, which is even more appalling." (이소영 더불어민주당 의원은 12일 페이스북에 “사진으로 보니 너무 기괴해서 오늘 일정 끝나고 직접 와봤다”며 사진을 찍어 올렸다. 이 의원은 “고즈넉하고 사방의 시야가 트여 걷기만 해도 기분 좋았던 그 광장에 동물 사체 뼈가 연상되는 기괴한 조형물을 누가, 왜 (설치했냐)”라며 “외교부 쪽에서 바라보니 세종대왕께서 창살에 갇힌 듯 보여 더욱 경악스럽다”고 했다.)

Rep. Lee further stated, "This isn't just a waste of budget; it's an act of 'violence' against Gwanghwamun Square, which belongs to our people. It's an 'ideological brushstroke' on our history and culture. It's horrifying." (이 의원은 “이건 단순한 예산 낭비가 아니라 우리 국민들의 것인 광화문 광장에 대한 ‘가해’다. 우리 역사와 우리 문화에 대한 ‘이념적 붓칠’이다. 끔찍하다”라고 덧붙였다.)

On the same day, the completion ceremony for the 'Garden of Gratitude' was held at Gwanghwamun Square, attended by Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party's candidate for Seoul mayor. The key feature of this facility, built near the statue of King Sejong in Gwanghwamun Square, is the above-ground 'Light of Gratitude 23.' It consists of 23 stone sculptures, each 6.25 meters tall, symbolizing the 23 countries that participated in the Korean War, including South Korea. Underground, an exhibition space has been created to honor the sacrifices of Korean War veterans. Around 20.7 billion won was invested in this project. (이날 광화문광장에서는 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 참여한 가운데 ‘감사의 정원’ 준공식이 열렸다. 광화문광장 세종대왕상 인근에 들어선 이 시설의 핵심은 지상부의 ‘감사의 빛 23’이다. 한국을 포함해 한국전쟁에 참전 23개국을 상징하는 6.25m 높이 석재 조형물 23개가 설치됐다. 지하에는 6·25 참전 용사들의 희생 등을 기리는 전시 공간이 조성됐다. 이번 사업엔 207억원가량의 예산이 투입됐다.)

In response, Han Ga-seon, spokesperson for the Fatherland Innovation Party, issued a commentary on the same day, stating, "207 billion won of Seoul's tax money wasted as campaign expenses for Oh Se-hoon," and criticized, "This is a move by candidate Oh, who is running for Seoul mayor in the local elections, to build up his record at the end of his term. It's essentially spending over 20 billion won of Seoul citizens' tax money to promote himself." (이에 한가선 조국혁신당 대변인은 이날 ‘오세훈 서울시장 후보의 선전 비용으로 낭비된 서울시 세금 207억원’이라는 논평을 내어 “이번 지방선거에서 서울시장에 출마하는 오 후보가 임기 말 업적 쌓기를 하려는 것”이라며 “자신을 홍보하기 위해 200억원이 넘는 서울 시민의 세금을 쓴 것이나 다름없다”고 비판했다.)

Criticism also flooded the social media (SNS) of the Seoul Metropolitan Government, which posted promotional content for the 'Garden of Gratitude' that day. On Seoul City's Facebook, comments on the post included, "It's an eyesore. Tear it down immediately," "That budget should have built houses or provided support for independence activists or war veterans," "They're crazy. 20 billion won for that. Since it's not your own money…," "Please, let's use the square as a square," and "I tolerated the Han River bus, but this is too much." (이날 서울시가 ‘감사의 정원’ 홍보 글을 올린 사회관계망서비스(SNS)에도 비판하는 댓글이 쏟아졌다. 서울시 페이스북을 보면 해당 게시물에는 “흉물스럽다. 당장 철거하라”, “그 예산으로 독립유공자나 참전 용사분들 집을 지어주든가 지원을 해줘야지”, “미쳤구나. 저기에 200억원. 자기 돈 아니라고…”, “광장을 제발 좀 광장답게 쓰자”, “한강 버스까진 참았는데 이건 아니다” 등의 댓글이 달렸다.)

On Seoul City's Instagram, comments included, "This should be placed near the War Memorial, why is it here in front of Gyeongbokgung?" and "If they have that much money to spend, it would be far better to support struggling veterans from the participating countries," "Is there that much surplus tax money?" and "I simply can't understand why they put it there." However, there were also some comments like, "It's moving," and "It's a meaningful monument that will go down in history." (서울시 인스타그램에도 “전쟁기념관 쪽으로 가야지, 이게 왜 경복궁 앞에 생기는 건지?”, “저런 데다 쓸 돈이면 참전국 중에 어렵게 생활하는 참전국 참전용사를 지원하는 게 훨씬 낫겠네”, “세금이 그렇게나 남아도나?”, “왜 거기에 하는지 도저히 이해가 안 간다” 등의 댓글이 달렸다. 다만 일부 “감동적이다”, “역사에 길이 남을 뜻깊은 조형물이다”라는 댓글도 있었다.)

In response, candidate Oh posted on Facebook after the completion ceremony, saying, "Despite the systematic obstruction and false incitement by the Lee Jae-myung government and the Democratic Party, the Garden of Gratitude has taken its place in a corner of Gwanghwamun Square and will serve a precious role." Oh also demanded of Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul mayor, "Do you agree with the claim that the Garden of Gratitude is a symbol of the far-right and militarism? State your clear position." (관련해 오 후보는 이날 준공식을 마친 뒤 페이스북에서 “이재명 정부와 민주당의 조직적 훼방과 거짓 선동에도 불구하고 감사의 정원은 광화문광장 한편에 자리 잡아 소중한 역할을 하게 됐다”고 말했다. 오 후보는 정원오 민주당 서울시장 후보를 향해 “감사의 정원이 극우와 군사주의의 상징이라는 주장에 동의하냐”며 “분명한 입장을 밝히라”고 요구하기도 했다.)

Candidate Oh also stated in an interview on SBS Radio's 'Kim Tae-hoon's Political Show' on the 13th, "When our students and citizens go and see it, they will feel bursting with pride." (오 후보는 13일 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오 ‘김태훈의 정치쇼’와의 인터뷰에서도 “우리 학생들이나 우리 국민들이 가서 봤을 때는 자부심 뿜뿜(할 것)”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Song Kyung-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (송경화 기자 freehwa@hani.co.kr)

item.title: PM Kim Urges Active Support for Labor-Management Dialogue to Prevent Samsung Strike (김 총리 “삼성전자 파업 않도록 노사 간 대화 적극 지원하라”)
item.description:
As post-mediation efforts through the Central Labor Relations Commission (CLRC) between Samsung Electronics’ labor and management have broken down, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok ordered on the 13th, "Actively support continuous dialogue between labor and management to ensure that, under no circumstances, it leads to a strike at Samsung Electronics." << The Office of the Prime Minister’s Secretariat issued a press release stating that Prime Minister Kim gave this directive during an emergency meeting with relevant ministers held that morning at his office in the Seoul Government Complex to address the Samsung Electronics strike situation. (삼성전자 노사의 중앙노동위원회(중노위)를 통한 사후 조정이 결렬된 가운데, 김민석 국무총리가 “어떤 경우에도 삼성전자 파업으로 이어지지 않게끔 노사 간의 대화가 지속적으로 이뤄지도록 적극 지원하라”고 13일 지시했다.)

Prime Minister Kim reportedly received a briefing on the results of the post-mediation, which continued until early that morning, from Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Young-hoon and the Vice Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy, and discussed the government’s future response direction regarding the Samsung Electronics strike. (국무조정실 국무총리비서실은 보도자료를 내어, 김 총리가 이날 오전 정부서울청사 국무총리 집무실에서 삼성전자 파업 관련 긴급 관계장관회의를 개최해 이렇게 지시했다고 밝혔다.)

"The Prime Minister expressed regret over the breakdown of the post-mediation," the Prime Minister’s Office said. "Considering the significant ripple effects on the national economy, he instructed that the situation be closely managed at the government level, while urging active support to ensure continuous dialogue between labor and management, so that it does not lead to a strike under any circumstances." (김 총리는 이날 김영훈 고용노동부 장관 및 산업통상부 차관에게 이날 새벽까지 진행된 사후조정 결과를 보고받고, 향후 삼성전자 파업과 관련한 정부의 대응방향을 논의했다고 한다.)

The post-mediation through the CLRC between Samsung Electronics’ labor and management ultimately broke down after nearly 17 hours of talks, which stretched from the previous day until early this morning. The labor union announced its intention to go on strike on the 21st but stated, "We are open to discussions if the company brings forth a more advanced proposal." (국무총리실은 “김 총리는 사후조정이 결렬된 점에 대해 안타까움을 표시했다”며 “국민 경제에 미치는 파급 효과의 중대성을 고려해 정부 차원에서 상황을 면밀하게 관리해 나갈 것을 지시하는 한편, 어떤 경우에도 파업으로 이어지지 않게끔 노사 간의 대화가 지속적으로 이뤄지도록 적극 지원할 것을 당부했다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (삼성전자 노사의 중앙노동위원회(중노위)를 통한 사후 조정은 전날부터 이날 새벽까지 17시간 가까이 이어간 끝에 최종 결렬됐다. 노동조합은 오는 21일 파업에 나서겠다는 뜻을 밝히면서도 “회사 쪽이 진전된 안건을 가져온다면 논의할 생각이 있다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Kim Jae-seop: “Jeong Won-o’s Assault Record Is a Drunken Disorderly Incident Unrelated to May 18”…Jeong Won-o’s Side: “Black Propaganda” (김재섭 “정원오 폭행 전과, 5·18 무관 주폭 사건”…정원오 쪽 “흑색 선전”)
item.description:
Kim Jae-seop, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, claimed that Jeong Won-o, the Democratic Party of Korea’s candidate for Seoul mayor, had a past assault record “unrelated to the May 18 Democratization Movement,” calling it “an incident where he forced a café owner to let a female employee stay overnight during a drinking session and threatened the owner for refusing.” Jeong’s side immediately refuted, stating “that is not true,” citing the court ruling and media reports from the time. Lawmaker Kim serves as the head of the election campaign committee for Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party’s candidate for Seoul mayor. <<> During a press conference at the National Assembly on the morning of the 13th, Kim said, “Candidate Jeong has explained that his assault record resulted from a dispute over differing views on the May 18 Democratization Movement, but evidence suggests that explanation is a lie,” adding that “it was a very serious ‘drunk disorderly conduct’ case with a criminal nature so severe that an ordinary suspect would likely have been detained.” Earlier, on Facebook, Jeong had admitted to being involved in an assault case 30 years ago, saying it was a “dispute over differing views on the May 18 Democratization Movement with a secretary to a Democratic Liberal Party lawmaker,” and apologized. <<> The evidence Kim presented that day included minutes from the 1995 Yangcheon-gu Council plenary session, which recorded then-council member Jang Haeng-il stating, “After the district office chief’s secretary and an aide drank 150,000 won worth of alcohol at a café, they demanded the owner let a female employee stay overnight. When the owner refused, they threatened, asking, ‘Do you want to continue doing business?’” Jang also claimed that when a secretary to a lawmaker at a nearby table intervened, “Secretary Kim and Aide Jeong asked, ‘Are you so great just because you’re a secretary?’ and assaulted him, causing injuries,” raising the issue with the then-district office chief. <<> Jeong’s side immediately countered. Jeong’s campaign said to reporters, “The court ruling on the case stated, ‘While sitting together with victim Lee, a secretary to Democratic Liberal Party lawmaker Park, and discussing political views, voices were raised due to differing party affiliations, leading to a fight where the assailant struck the victim’s face multiple times with fists and feet,’” adding that “right after the incident, the media reported that ‘the assault occurred during an argument over the June 27 election and the punishment of those involved in the May 18 incident.’” Lee Hae-sik, a lawmaker and head of Jeong’s campaign’s general election committee, posted on Facebook, “The People Power Party’s use of baseless one-sided claims as black propaganda without fact-checking is, in a word, hopeless.” <<> Yoo Young-jae, reporter: young@hani.co.kr (김재섭 국민의힘 의원이 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보의 과거 폭행 전과에 대해 “5·18 민주화운동과는 전혀 무관했다”며 “술자리에서 카페 주인에게 여종업원과의 외박을 강요하고 이를 거절하는 주인을 협박한 사건”이라고 주장했다. 정 후보 쪽은 즉각 “사실이 아니다”며 당시 사건 판결문과 언론 보도를 근거로 제시했다. 김 의원은 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보 캠프 선거대책위원장을 맡고 있다.)

item.title: Worried About Losing North Jeolla Province Governor... Jung Cheong-rae: "Party, Government, and Blue House Must Act as One to Speed Up Saemangeum Development" (전북지사 뺏길라…정청래 “당정청 한몸 가야 새만금 개발도 속도”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated regarding the "National Dividend" system proposed by Blue House Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom, "It seems there was no prior discussion with the party." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 김용범 청와대 정책실장이 화두를 던진 ‘국민배당금’ 제도와 관련해 “당과 어떤 대화는 없었던 것 같다”고 말했다.)

Leader Jung gave this response on the 13th at a press conference held in the party leader's office at the National Assembly regarding the June 3 local elections, when asked about his position on Kim's previous day's proposal for "distributing excess profits from the artificial intelligence (AI) industry as a national dividend." Jung said, "We are entering an uncharted path during this civilizational turning point driven by AI. I believe that's why Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom made that proposal. The Blue House has already stated it's a personal opinion, and rather than rushing into action, I think academic research and consideration should precede it." <<> Regarding the turmoil in the North Jeolla Province election scene, where expelled party member Kim Gwan-young is running as an independent, leader Jung remarked, "Nine trillion won is being invested in Saemangeum, which was neglected by previous administrations. If the party, government, and Blue House act as one with a unified purpose, wouldn't Saemangeum's development be pursued with greater speed and momentum?" <<> On the "standard for victory" in this election, he emphasized again, "As party leader, I hope we win even one more seat. Candidates must be truly humble, and the party leadership must also be truly humble." <<> Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (정 대표는 13일 국회 당대표 회의실에서 열린 6·3 지방선거 관련 기자회견 직후 김 실장이 전날 제안한 ‘인공지능(AI) 산업 초과이익 국민배당금에 대한 입장’을 묻자 이렇게 답했다. 정 대표는 “인공지능으로 인한 문명사적 대전환의 시기에 이전에 가보지 못한 길을 가게 된다. 그래서 김용범 정책실장이 그런 제안을 했다고 본다”며 “청와대는 이미 (김 실장의) 개인 의견이라고 했고, 당장 뭘 하자는 것보다 학계 연구와 고찰이 선행돼야 하지 않을까 생각한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Jung Won-oh: "Property Tax Reduction for Single-Home Owners Without Income" (정원오 “소득 없는 1주택자 재산세 감면”)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul Mayor, alongside Democratic Party candidates for the heads of all 25 Seoul district offices, announced a pledge to "reduce property taxes for single-home owners without income." (정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보가 민주당 서울 25개 구청장 후보들과 함께 “소득 없는 1주택자의 재산세를 감면하겠다”는 공약을 발표했다.)

On the 13th, Candidate Jung held a press conference with the Democratic Party's 25 Seoul district office head candidates at the National Assembly and stated, "We will pursue temporary measures to reduce the increase in property taxes this year caused by the rise in publicly announced land prices." (정 후보는 13일 국회에서 민주당 서울 25개 구청장 후보들과 함께 기자회견을 열어 “공시가격 상승으로 올해 늘어난 재산세 증가분을 한시적으로 감면하는 조치를 추진하겠다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

The property tax reduction promised by Candidate Jung targets "Seoul citizens who own one home, are above a certain age, and have no business or earned income," adding, "We will establish criteria by also considering financial income and rental income." He further stated, "We will reasonably review the age standard by referencing the current comprehensive real estate tax's elderly tax credit threshold of age 60." (정 후보가 약속한 재산세 감면 대상은 “1주택자 중 일정 연령 이상이면서 사업소득과 근로소득이 없는 (서울)시민”으로, “금융소득과 임대소득(여부)도 고려해 기준을 정하겠다”고 했다. “연령 기준은 현행 종합부동산세 고령자 세액공제 기준인 만 60세를 참고해 합리적으로 검토하겠다”고 했다.)

Regarding the timing of the reduction, Candidate Jung said, "Seoul City and the 25 district offices will cooperate to push for revisions to district ordinances, and we will begin preparatory work immediately upon the start of my term." He added, "We will work to ensure that the reduction for this year's increase is reflected in the property taxes levied in September, but depending on conditions, we will also consider handling the July portion through a refund method." (정 후보는 감면 시점에 대해 “서울시와 25개 자치구가 협력해 구별 조례 개정을 추진하고, 임기 시작과 동시에 준비 작업에 착수하겠다”며 “오는 9월 부과되는 재산세에 올해 증가분 감면이 반영될 수 있도록 추진하되, 일정 여건에 따라 7월분은 환급 방식으로 처리하는 방안도 검토하겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Jung explained the background of the pledge, saying, "This year, the publicly announced price of apartment buildings in Seoul rose by 18.6%. The rise in publicly announced prices directly leads to an increased property tax burden." He continued, "For citizens whose income has decreased or stopped after retirement, yet the publicly announced price of the home they've lived in their whole lives has gone up, suddenly facing a larger property tax burden is a reality that cannot be taken lightly. It's not about multiple-home owners for speculative purposes, but about easing the property tax burden for retired generations who live by protecting their single lifelong home." (정 후보는 “올해 공동주택 공시가격은 서울 기준 18.6% 상승했다. 공시가격 상승은 곧바로 재산세 부담 증가로 이어진다”며 “평생 살아온 집의 공시가격은 올랐는데, 은퇴 이후 소득은 줄거나 끊긴 시민들에게 재산세 부담까지 갑자기 커진 현실은 결코 가볍게 봐서는 안 된다. 투기 목적의 다주택자가 아니라, 평생 살아온 집 한 채를 지키며 살아가는 은퇴 세대의 재산세 부담을 덜어드리겠다는 것”이라고 공약 추진 배경을 설명했다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Reviewing National Dividend from Excess Tax Revenue... Don't Slander by Calling It 'Excess Profits'" (이 대통령 “초과세수 국민 배당 검토…‘초과이윤’ 아니니 음해 말라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 13th that Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom's remark about a "national dividend" is a proposal to utilize excess tax revenue, and criticized some media for labeling it as "excess profits," calling it "fake news for manipulating public opinion." (이재명 대통령이 13일 김용범 정책실장의 ‘국민 배당금’ 발언은 초과세수를 활용하자는 주장인데 ‘초과이윤’으로 쓰는 언론이 있다며 “여론조작용 가짜뉴스”라고 말했다.)

President Lee posted on X (formerly Twitter) that day, saying: "What Director Kim said was 'a review of distributing to the people the nation's excess tax revenue generated from excess profits in the artificial intelligence (AI) sector.' Some media edited this remark and spread slanderous fake news claiming that 'Director Kim argued for a review of distributing corporate excess profits to the people.'" (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “김 실장이 한 말은 ‘인공지능(AI) 부문’ 초과이윤으로 발생하는 국가의 초과세수를 국민에게 배당하는 방안 검토”인데 “일부 언론이 이 발언을 편집해 ‘김 실장이 기업의 초과이윤을 국민배당하는 방안 검토를 주장했다’는 음해성 가짜뉴스를 유포”한 것이라 지적했다.)

He further said: "Director Kim denied this, kindly provided an explanation—not a defense—stating it was a proposal to review distributing excess tax revenue. Even after related reports came out, why do they continue to engage in such slanderous reporting? We must always remember that political criticism or attacks, if not based on facts, harm democracy." (그러면서 이 대통령은 “김 실장이 이를 부인하고, 초과세수 배당 검토 주장이었다며 해명 아닌 설명을 친절하게 했고 관련 보도까지 났음에도 여전히 이런 음해성 보도를 하는 이유가 뭐냐”며 “정치적 비난이나 비판도 사실에 기반하지 않으면 민주주의를 해치게 된다는 점을 반드시 기억해야 한다”고 말했다.)

The article shared by President Lee contained a claim by People Power Party lawmaker Park Soo-young, who said that Director Kim's proposal to review an AI national dividend "brings Venezuela to mind." Park further criticized: "The chief of the presidential office's policy bureau argued for a 'corporate profit distribution system' that would distribute corporate excess profits to all citizens in a socialist manner." (이 대통령이 공유한 기사는 박수영 국민의힘 의원이 김 실장의 인공지능 국민배당금 검토 제안을 두고 “베네수엘라가 떠오르게 한다”고 주장하는 내용이었다. 박 의원은 그러면서 “기업 초과이익을 전 국민에게 사회주의식으로 나눠주자는 ‘기업이익 배급제’를 청와대 정책실장이 주장한 것”이라고 비판했다.)

Previously, Director Kim mentioned the "national dividend" in a Facebook post the day before, stating: "If a strategic position in the AI infrastructure supply chain creates a structural boom and leads to unprecedented excess tax revenue, how to use that money is not a matter of choice but a question that must be considered." This remark later sparked controversy over the recovery of corporate excess profits, leading to ongoing political disputes. (앞서 김 실장은 전날 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “인공지능 인프라 공급망에서의 전략적 위치가 구조적 호황을 만들고, 역대급 초과세수로 이어진다면 그 돈을 어떻게 쓸지는 선택의 문제가 아니라 응당 고민해야 할 문제”라며 ‘국민 배당금’을 언급했다. 이 발언이 이후 기업 초과이윤 환수 논란으로 번지면서 정치권 공방이 이어지고 있다.)

item.title: Kwak Sang-eon: "It's been 17 years since the late president left, but still mocking posts... all will face legal action" (곽상언 “노 전 대통령 떠난 지 17년인데 아직도 조롱 글…모두 법적 대응”)
item.description:
Kwak Sang-eon, a Democratic Party lawmaker and the son-in-law of the late former President Roh Moo-hyun, announced on the 13th a firm legal response policy against malicious false information distribution and hate posts targeting the former president. (고 노무현 전 대통령의 사위인 곽상언 더불어민주당 의원이 13일 노 전 대통령에 대한 악의적인 허위사실 유포와 혐오 게시물에 대한 강경한 법적 대응 방침을 밝혔다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly that day, Rep. Kwak stated, "There is a flood of videos and posts online mocking and hating President Roh Moo-hyun," and added, "Starting today, I will file criminal complaints for defamation of the deceased, proceed with phased criminal charges, and also pursue civil lawsuits for damages against those who repeatedly post hate content for profit." He also said he would seek a preliminary injunction from the court to demand the deletion and prohibition of neglect of hate posts on platforms such as DC Inside and Ilbe Storage (Ilbe), as well as on YouTube. <<> Kwak explained the background of the lawsuit, saying, "I hesitated about this for a long time because it could place the name of someone who has passed away back in the middle of unnecessary turmoil. However, even 17 years later, the ongoing behavior of treating former President Roh's life and death as a 'game' is causing suffering to our family, including the children." He added, "This happens anew every day for 17 years, and I'm sorry to the children that the time I believed silence was the solution was too long." Former President Roh passed away on May 23, 2007. <<> Rep. Kwak emphasized, "President Roh Moo-hyun stood on the side of freedom of expression regarding criticism and satire directed at him, stressing that citizens who criticized him were exercising their 'natural right as sovereign citizens.' However, debasing the dignity of the deceased, spreading obvious falsehoods as if they were true facts, and repeatedly wielding verbal violence while mocking the pain of the bereaved family—this is neither democracy nor freedom of expression." <<> He also criticized the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation, saying, "You have failed to resolve the issue of hate content and have effectively neglected it," and expressed hope, "that it will be reborn as a responsible institution safeguarding Roh Moo-hyun's values and memory as public assets of democracy." Additionally, he requested information and communication service providers to promptly delete and block related posts on their platforms. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (곽 의원은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “온라인 상에 노무현 대통령을 조롱하며 혐오하는 영상과 글이 난무하고 있다”며 “오늘부터 사자명예훼손죄로 형사고소장으로 내고 단계적 형사고소를 진행하는 한편, 혐오 게시물을 반복적으로 게시하며 수익을 얻는 이들에게는 민사상 손해배상 소송도 진행하겠다”고 말했다. 그는 또, 디시인사이드와 일간베스트저장소(일베) 등 인터넷과 유튜브에 게시된 혐오 게시물에 대해 ‘게시글 삭제 및 방치 금지’를 구하는 가처분을 법원에 신청하겠다고 했다.)

item.title: Won Seong-chul Says "Reviewing Participation in U.S.-Proposed Maritime Freedom of Navigation Initiative in the Strait of Hormuz" (위성락 “미국 제안한 호르무즈해협 해양자유구상 참여 검토”)
item.description:
National Security Office Director Won Seong-chul stated on the 13th that the government is reviewing participation in the Maritime Freedom of Navigation (MFC) initiative proposed by the United States to ensure free navigation in the Strait of Hormuz. (위성락 국가안보실장이 13일 호르무즈해협의 자유로운 항행을 위해 미국이 제안한 해양자유구상(MFC)에 대한 참여를 검토하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

During a meeting with the Newspaper and Broadcasting Editors' Association held at the Press Center in Jongno-gu, Seoul, Director Won said, "The U.S. has proposed cooperative measures related to the Maritime Freedom of Navigation initiative and the 'Freedom Project' (Project Freedom) for free passage in the Strait of Hormuz. Our government, as with other international cooperations, is reviewing the Maritime Freedom of Navigation initiative." (위 실장은 이날 서울 종로구 프레스센터에서 열린 신문방송편집인협회 간담회에서 “미국은 해양자유구상과 ‘해방 프로젝트’(프로젝트 프리덤)라는 호르무즈해협 자유통항과 관련해 협력방안을 제시한 바 있다”며 “우리 정부는 여타 국가협력에 대해서 마찬가지로 해양자유구상에 대해 검토를 진행하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the Freedom Project proposed by U.S. President Donald Trump, Director Won had previously stated on the 6th that since the U.S. withdrew its proposal, there was no longer a need to consider participation. The Maritime Freedom of Navigation initiative is a multinational coalition led by the U.S. State Department and Central Command to stabilize the Strait of Hormuz and ensure freedom of passage, while the Freedom Project was closer to an assistance operation to immediately free ships trapped in the strait. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 제안한 해방 프로젝트와 관련해, 위 실장은 지난 6일 미국이 제안을 거둬들임에 따라 더 이상 참여 검토가 필요하지 않다고 밝힌 바 있다. 해양자유구상은 미국 국무부와 중부사령부가 주도해 호르무즈해협 안정화와 통항 자유를 위해 추진하는 다국적 연합체라면, 해방 프로젝트는 당장 해협 내에 갇힌 선박을 빼내기 위한 조력 작전에 가깝다.)

Regarding the transition of wartime operational control (OPCON) between South Korea and the U.S., Director Won said, "The South Korean military is securing capabilities by increasing the defense budget to play a leading role in defending the Korean Peninsula, completing the roadmap for regaining wartime OPCON this year, and pushing for the completion of the 'Full Operational Capability' verification." (위 실장은 한·미 간 전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환과 관련해 “한국군은 한반도 방위의 주도적인 역할을 할 수 있도록 국방비 증액 등으로 역량을 확보하고, 올해 전작권 회복 로드맵을 완성하고, ‘완전 운영능력 검증’ 완료도 추진하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Currently, South Korea and the U.S. are conducting a three-step verification process under the Conditions-Based OPCON Transition Plan (COTP). The verification process involves three stages: △ Initial Operational Capability (IOC), △ Full Operational Capability (FOC), and △ Full Mission Capability (FMC). It has been reported that South Korean and U.S. military authorities are considering presenting a target year for the OPCON transition if the second-stage verification is completed at the South Korea-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting (SCM) scheduled for November this year. (현재 한·미 양국은 ‘조건에 기초한 전작권 전환계획(COTP)’에 따라 3단계 검증 절차를 진행 중이다. 검증 절차는 △최초작전운용능력(IOC) △완전운용능력(FOC) △완전임무수행능력(FMC) 등 3단계를 거친다. 한·미 군 당국은 올해 11월 예정된 한·미 안보협의회의(SCM)에서 2단계 검증이 마무리될 경우, 전작권 전환 목표 연도를 제시하는 방안을 검토 중인 것으로 전해졌다.)
